items.source: First ensures that the given value is coerceable into the type expected by this option, then returns the result of Object.toString() called on the given value. If this option is escaping quotes (escapesValue() is true), then single quotes will be escaped, and if this option is quoting values ( quotesValue() is true), then the value will be surrounded by single quotes. Given null, returns an empty string.
items.translation: 首先确保给定值可转换为该选项所期望的类型，然后返回在给定值上调用Object.toString()的结果。如果此选项为转义引号（即escapesValue()为true），则单引号将被转义；如果此选项为引用值（即quotesValue()为true），则值将被单引号包围。若给定值为 null，则返回空字符串。
